rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a physically gathered crowd of people.

example.english: The crowd outside the station is so packed that the road is completely blocked.
example.traditional: 車站外面嘅人群太逼，搞到條路塞晒。
example.jyutping: ce1 zaam6 ngoi6 min6 ge3 jan4 kwan4 taai3 bik1 gaau2 dou3 tiu4 lou6 sak1 saai3

rows.note: Use this for a group of people linked by a shared interest or characteristic.

example.english: There’s a crowd at our company who love going for dim sum together after work.
example.traditional: 我哋公司有一班人好鍾意放工後一齊飲茶。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 jau5 jat1 baan1 jan4 hou2 zung1 ji3 fong3 gung1 hau6 jat1 cai4 jam2 caa4
